jalapeños.Bake in the oven at 200°C for 8 minutes, not the microwave.Top with diced tomato and sour cream.MainsManhattan deli pastramiSteamed pastrami piled on rye with spicy mustard, potato salad on the sideHow to make it500g pastrami8 slices of rye bread3 tbsp American mustard600g potatoes3 tbsp mayonnaise1 celery stick, diced1 tbsp chopped dill4 whole dill picklesBoil the potatoes until tender, cool and toss with the mayonnaise, celery and dill.Steam the pastrami for 10 minutes until soft.Pile high on the rye spread with spicy mustard.Serve each sandwich with a whole dill pickle.Top-floor steak DianeGreta proposes on the top floor.How to make itAs written, serves 4Pounded beef fillet seared and finished in a pan sauce of mushrooms, brandy, mustard, Worcestershire and cream, with crisp potato rösti and green beans.Grate 800g potatoes, squeeze dry, mix with salt and fry as 4 rösti in butter for 6 minutes a side.Pound 4 x 180g beef fillet steaks to 1.5cm and sear in a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, then rest.Add 20g butter, 1 diced shallot and 150g sliced mushrooms and cook 3 minutes.Add 50ml brandy, then 1 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 150ml cream and bubble 2 jam.Top with melted chocolate and chill to set.Cut into small bars.DrinksMogwai-safe lychee and lime fizzLychee, lime and mint on crushed ice. Stir gently.Pour into glasses and garnish with a lychee on a skewer and a mint sprig.
